chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

It is written in the Torah which has not been altered that Musa (peace be upon him) asked his Lord (may He be exalted) saying: 'My God! A situation comes upon me such that it would not be honourable and majestic for You that I should mention You therein'. So He said: 'O Musa! My Mention is good upon every state'.
ai.seo_question: What did God say to Musa about remembering Him in all states?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (as) cites an unaltered portion of the Torah to affirm that divine remembrance is perpetually virtuous, countering concerns about context or state. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that dhikr is not merely a ritual but a continuous spiritual state, reinforcing the obligation of remembering Allah in every gathering as a fundamental aspect of worship.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It is Written in the Torah - which has not been altered - that Musa<sup>as</sup> asked his<sup>as</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> saying: ‘My<sup>as</sup> God! A situation comes upon me<sup>as</sup> such that it would not be honourable and majestic for You<sup>azwj</sup> that I<sup>as</sup> should mention You<sup>azwj</sup> therein’. So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Musa<sup>as</sup>! My<sup>azwj</sup> Mention is good upon every state”’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“It is written in the Torah, which is not changed, that Moses asked his Lord saying, ‘O Lord, sometimes I find myself in certain gatherings where I feel speaking of Y ou is not worthy of Your Honor and Glory. He (Allah) said, Moses, speaking of Me is good in all conditions.’”
